decisions.statement: Every type generator answers here, whatever a change would have turned.
The change the generators are handed moves nothing, so they read the tree as it is.
A generator that broke is refused rather than passed over as nothing differing.
A file the generators write is put in place whole, as the index's own files are.
Nothing here weighs a file no type generator writes.

definition: every file the type generators write, worked out again from the pages
